about: Evaluation scenario catalogue for the live-drive simulation. Single source used by pipeline/collect.py. Math.random is replaced by a seeded generator, seed = seed_base*7919 + mode offset (explore 0, evaluation 100003) + SEED_OFF. Runs are statistically repeatable, not bit-identical (the 2.5 s page-load warm-up runs in real time; see README.md).
ego_driver: automatic: brake when time-to-collision < 2.5 s and speed > 2 m/s, else accelerate up to ego_speed_mps

loss.effect: +0.60 loss probability on every V2X message; +0.25 on edge-sync messages

lat.effect: +280-360 ms on every V2X and edge-sync message (uniform)

lidar.effect: range 75 m -> 35 m, position noise sigma 0.15 m -> 2.2 m

spoof.what: position spoofing by one V2X vehicle
spoof.effect: the nearest connected vehicle inside LiDAR range reports its position 11 m ahead and 3.5 m sideways

conditions.name: normal_fast
conditions.purpose: higher ego speed, faster bearing drift of mmWave beams

conditions.name: lidar_degraded
conditions.purpose: weaker verification of the twin by the ego's own sensor
